messages.subject: Jake Essex for Compton Club?
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm Natalie. I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Jake would be a great fit for Compton Club - and he'd love to come and perform for you.

He's performed in over 500 venues over the past 10 years and built a good reputation for singing the classics without the corny impersonation. He's branching out to new venues now.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist from Essex. 50s, 60s and into the 70s - Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis & more. He is the act - no tribute, no jumpsuit, no corny impersonations. Own PA, fully self-contained, no deposit.

Have a look: www.jakeessex.co.uk

Saturdays, Sundays and functions this year and into 2027 - if a date works, reply here and I'll lock it.

Natalie
